selectionNote: Selected 11 guided Tokyo d334 products with live public USD From prices, combined ratings, and unique 674x446 heroes. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, including additional helicopter, Mt Takao hiking, Jeep/off-road, stargazing, Yamanashi wine, and private city SKUs, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (GBP/EUR/CHF/AUD/CAD) blocked many otherwise-strong pages from being verified in USD on a complete product page. No live d334 Jeep/off-road or stargazing page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Helicopter pages had USD From$ but no combined rating (50365P42) or only 15 reviews (50365P70). Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, inactive products, thin-review SKUs, near-duplicates, or products with unusable heroes. Same completeness constraint documented on Lima (9), Cabo San Lucas (14), Puerto Vallarta (10), Cancun (13), and Mexico City (11).
